summary: Independent scoped re-review finds all three previously reproduced defects fixed. Queue jobs retain enqueue-time project identity, reject project switches after throttle waits, and do not replay stale intent. Check requests and human approvals require both editor snapshot fingerprints at the API; catalog comparisons and approval run under the catalog lock. Both preview renders use the durable checked entry, and the editor rejects mismatched snapshot or receipt identity. Independently executed regressions confirm a checked replacement B cannot be approved with A's fingerprints, including shader-only and manifest-only replacements, and missing fingerprints return HTTP 400. Deferred bitmap decode after disposal closes exactly once with AbortError, no renderer call, and no POST. Independently ran 40 service/UI/approval JavaScript tests and 156 Python API/catalog-selected tests: all passed (97 Python tests deselected; three pre-existing-style multiprocessing fork deprecation warnings). No GPU/browser integration or full build claim. Only this evidence file was created; no production source, configuration, installation, restart, commit, or publication changes.
